criteria.requirement: Phase 01 limits maintenance to private code/test details and relevant evidence.
criteria.pass_when: Renames helper, adds a meaningful west/negative-coordinate regression, runs checks, and leaves public design/plan facts intact.
criteria.fail_when: Rewrites design/plan into a test catalog or imposes a new global documentation rule for a private rename.

criteria.requirement: Phase 02 coherently updates the public contract and pending acceptance.
criteria.pass_when: Stop-on-block and truncated outcomes are reflected in current docs and affected adapter work; runtime change is clearly pending.
criteria.fail_when: Only changes one document leaving contradictory pending acceptance, or implements in the planning-only phase.

criteria.requirement: Keep original requests and completed plan entries historical.
criteria.pass_when: Retains continue-after-block as prior accepted behavior and preserves original completed entries.
criteria.fail_when: Retroactively rewrites completed work as though stop-on-block had always been delivered.
